note: Daily specials. One per day when no story mission is open, or alongside one. {n} and {dish} are filled by the game. n = round(nPerRank[rank]) (last value repeats for higher ranks). Pay = round(pay x day income at that rank). Day income: 28, 55, 100, 180, 300, 450, then about 620, 800, 1000, 1250, 1500.
